ingredients.name: Assorted Lettuce
ingredients.originalText: 2 cup assorted Lettuce, chopped or torn

ingredients.name: Pitted Black Olives
ingredients.originalText: 1/2 cup pitted Black Olives (preferably brine-cured), coarsely chopped

ingredients.name: Salt and freshly ground Black Pepper
ingredients.originalText: Salt and freshly ground Black Pepper

instructions.text: Set out a large salad bowl, small dressing bowl, whisk, cutting board, and knife. Wash the lettuce, 4 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1 bell pepper, 1 small onion, parsley, and any fresh herbs before cutting.

Chop or tear enough lettuce for 2 cups. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Remove the cucumber seeds if desired and slice it. Remove the pepper stem and seeds and cut into strips. Peel and thinly slice the onion.

Coarsely chop 1/2 cup pitted black olives, chop enough parsley for 1/4 cup, and finely chop enough garlic for 1/2 teaspoon. Crumble 3/5 cup feta cheese. Put the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, and olives in the large bowl.

In the small bowl, whisk 6 tablespoons olive oil, 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar, and 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice. Add the chopped garlic and parsley, 1/2 teaspoon oregano, and 1/2 teaspoon dill weed. The source allows salt and black pepper to taste.
Whisk until the dressing looks evenly mixed, then drizzle it over the vegetables. Use two large spoons to gently lift and turn the salad until lightly coated without crushing the tomatoes.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta over the top and serve. The source gives a yield of 4–6 servings; keep that range rather than assuming one exact serving count.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. Combine the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, bell pepper, olives in a bowl.
2. In the small bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, herbs, spices, and the lemon juice.
3. Drizzle dressing over the salad.
4. Sprinkle cheese over and serve.
